title: Earlier undisclosed events before WWII

tellings.quote: I mean, there's some other stuff, too, that I can't talk about that was way before that.

plain: There were said to be secret events involving unexplained craft much earlier than the ones usually talked about, which this story places before or during the Second World War. David Grusch, a former intelligence official turned whistleblower, hints at this to Michels but will not explain: "there's some other stuff, too, that I can't talk about that was way before that." If true, it would push the hidden history back further than the familiar timeline starting in the late 1940s.
